q.zh: Sleepy 和 WakeUp 课程表是什么关系？
q.en: What is the relationship between Sleepy and WakeUp Course Schedule?

inline.v: 没有隶属关系。Sleepy 是独立的开源课表项目。Android 版兼容 WakeUp 的部分数据格式，也支持联网解析其分享口令；这不表示由 WakeUp 团队开发，或能使用对方全部服务。

There is no affiliation. Sleepy is an independent open-source schedule project. The Android app supports some WakeUp data formats and can resolve its online share codes. This does not mean it is developed by the WakeUp team or can use all of WakeUp's services.

q.zh: Sleepy 免费吗？有广告或内购吗？
q.en: Is Sleepy free? Does it have ads or in-app purchases?

inline.v: 免费，许可证是 GPL-3.0，没有广告、订阅、内购或付费等级。正式 APK 从
GitHub Releases
下载。
It is free under the GPL-3.0 license, with no ads, subscriptions, in-app purchases or paid tiers. Download official APKs from
GitHub Releases

q.zh: 需要注册账号吗？
q.en: Do I need to register an account?

inline.v: 不需要注册 Sleepy 账号，也不用向 Sleepy 提供邮箱或手机号；可直接手动建表、导入本地文件。教务直连仍可能要求学校账号、学号、密码或验证码，由你在学校页面登录。学校登录与 Sleepy 账号不是一回事。

You do not need a Sleepy account or need to give Sleepy an email address or phone number. You can create schedules manually or import local files immediately. Direct academic-affairs import may still require a school account, student ID, password or verification code, entered on the school's login page. A school login is separate from a Sleepy account.

q.zh: 会收集或上传数据吗？
q.en: Does it collect or upload data?

inline.v: 课表和设置存储在本机，不要求登录项目云端账号，也未集成 Firebase Analytics、Crashlytics、Sentry、Bugsnag、AppCenter、Bugly 等分析或崩溃上报 SDK。普通查看、编辑课表可离线完成。
联网操作包括教务导入访问学校站点、WakeUP 分享口令解析访问第三方
api.wakeup.fun
、节假日数据刷新，以及通过 GitHub 或项目镜像检查版本、下载更新。使用系统日历、系统分享或手动导出后，数据去向由所选应用和操作决定。“本地存储”不等于所有操作都不联网。关于页提供隐私政策链接。

Schedules and settings are stored on your device. No project cloud account is required, and the app includes no analytics or crash-reporting SDKs such as Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Sentry, Bugsnag, AppCenter or Bugly. Ordinary schedule viewing and editing work offline.
Network operations include visiting school sites for academic-affairs import, contacting the third-party
api.wakeup.fun

service to resolve WakeUP share codes, refreshing holiday data, and checking versions or downloading updates through GitHub or the project mirror. When you use the system calendar, system sharing or manual export, where the data goes depends on the app and action you choose. Local storage does not mean every operation is offline. The About page links to the privacy policy.

q.zh: 谁维护？在哪里反馈问题？
q.en: Who maintains it? Where do I report problems?

inline.v: 项目由 Lingion 维护。Bug、新学校适配和建议可发到
GitHub Issues
，讨论见
Discussions
。不要公开账号、密码、验证码、Cookie、token 或未脱敏个人课表。
Lingion maintains the project. Report bugs, request school support or suggest features through
GitHub Issues
; use
Discussions
for discussion. Never post accounts, passwords, verification codes, cookies, tokens or unredacted personal schedules publicly.

q.zh: 如何支持这个项目？
q.en: How can I support the project?

inline.v: 可自愿赞助，支付宝和微信收款码见
赞助页
。赞助不解锁额外功能，应用没有付费等级。
Voluntary sponsorship is welcome. Alipay and WeChat payment codes are on the
sponsor page
. Sponsorship does not unlock extra features; the app has no paid tiers.

q.zh: 支持什么 Android 版本？
q.en: Which Android versions are supported?

inline.v: 最低 Android 8.0（API 26），target 和 compile SDK 为 37。正式包名是
com.lingion.sleepy
，当前源码的 debug 包名是
com.lingion.sleepy.debug
，数据分别保存。最低系统要求不代表所有图形效果和厂商实况通知都能在旧系统上工作。
The minimum is Android 8.0 (API 26); target and compile SDK are 37. The release package is
com.lingion.sleepy
, and the debug package in this source version is
com.lingion.sleepy.debug
. Their data is stored separately. Meeting the minimum system requirement does not mean every visual effect or vendor live notification works on older systems.

q.zh: 当前版本是多少？
q.en: What is the current version?

inline.v: 本页描述 v1.0.63，versionCode 为 10063。该正式版发布于 2026-11-01 UTC；已安装版本可在应用“关于”页查看。下载以
v1.0.63 发布页
为准；之后的源码提交和 debug 包不自动算作此正式版已有功能。
This page describes v1.0.63, with versionCode 10063. This release was published on 2026-11-01 UTC. Check the app's About page for your installed version. Download from the
v1.0.63 release page
; later source commits and debug builds do not automatically count as features in this official release.

q.zh: 提供哪些 APK ABI？
q.en: Which APK ABIs are provided?

inline.v: 正式发布提供四种 APK：

items.v: ：32 位 ARM 设备，也称 V7A。
：对应架构的 Android 设备或模拟器。
：通用包，不确定架构时可先选择它。

inline.v: 发布页提供
sha256sums.txt
，可核对下载文件。不要把 PR CI 的测试产物当成正式更新。
The official release provides four APK variants:

items.v: : Android devices or emulators with this architecture.
: a universal package to try if you are unsure of the architecture.

inline.v: The release page provides
sha256sums.txt
to verify downloaded files. Do not treat PR CI test artifacts as official updates.

q.zh: 有 iOS、Windows 或网页版本吗？
q.en: Are there iOS, Windows or web versions?

inline.v: iOS 版在独立仓库
lingion/sleepy-ios
维护，基于 SwiftUI + WidgetKit 原生实现，iOS 16.0 起，与 Android 版功能对齐。目前以
Apple TestFlight 公测
作为唯一合法上线途径分发，加入公测后即可直接安装体验并自动接收版本推送。另有
官网
和
在线体验
；网页预览不等于原生应用全部能力。Windows 原生版暂无。
The iOS app is maintained in the separate
lingion/sleepy-ios
repository, built natively with SwiftUI + WidgetKit for iOS 16.0 and up, feature-aligned with Android releases. It is currently distributed via
Apple TestFlight public beta
as the only official release route, which can be installed directly and receives updates automatically. There is also an
official website
and an
online trial
; the web preview does not provide every native app capability. There is no native Windows version yet.

q.zh: 支持哪些界面语言？
q.en: Which interface languages are supported?

inline.v: Android v1.0.63 包含简体中文、繁体中文、英文、日文和西班牙文。网页官网目前提供中文、英文两种语言，不能将两者的语言范围混为一谈。
Android v1.0.63 includes Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese and Spanish. The website currently offers Chinese and English. These are separate language sets.

q.zh: 我的学校不在名单里怎么办？
q.en: What if my school is not on the list?

inline.v: 先在学校选择页搜索全名或别名，再尝试输入教务 URL 识别。目录收录不等于已适配，更不代表登录一定成功。没有对应条目、显示待适配或导入失败时，可使用
学校适配模板
提供公开教务地址、失败页面和步骤；不要提供登录凭据或未脱敏数据。

Search the full name or an alias on the school selection page, then try entering the academic-affairs URL for identification. A catalog listing does not mean a school is supported or that login is guaranteed to succeed. If the entry is missing, marked as pending support or fails to import, use the
school adaptation template
to provide the public academic-affairs address, failing page and steps. Do not submit login credentials or unredacted data.

q.zh: 学校目录有多少条？哪些已经配置？
q.en: How many catalog entries are there, and which are configured?

inline.v: v1.0.63 的目录快照共 4140 条。按应用状态规则归一后：

items.v: 2 条。其中 348 条省略状态字段，按兼容规则计入 supported，不是另加 348 条。
48 条。有可用解析通路的条目需要确认后尝试。
253 条，不能直接启动教务导入。

inline.v: 这些是目录状态数，不代表全部院校都经过逐校在线验证或保证导入成功。还需有效入口、解析器和学校服务可用。拾光来源覆盖 264 所学校，与最终选择
sg_asset
通路的 43 条不是同一统计口径；不能据此宣传 264 所均已实测。配置数据和来源见
目录说明
The v1.0.63 catalog snapshot contains 4140 entries. After normalization under the app's status rules:

items.v: . Of these, 348 omit the status field and count as supported under compatibility rules; they are not another 348 entries.
. Entries with an available parser route can be tried after confirmation.
. These cannot launch academic-affairs import directly.

inline.v: These are catalog status counts, not a claim that every school has been individually verified online or is guaranteed to import. A valid entry point, parser and available school service are still needed. The Shiguang source covers 264 schools; that is a different measure from the 43 entries that ultimately use the
sg_asset
route. It does not mean all 264 have been tested live. See the
catalog documentation
for configuration data and sources.

q.zh: 从目录里未验证的学校导入成功了，维护者怎么知道？
q.en: I imported successfully from an unverified catalog school. How can I tell the maintainer?

inline.v: 成功后可复制包含版本、日期、校名、目录 ID、协议和课程数的报告，自行粘贴到 Issues 或 Discussions。该报告入口不自动联网上传；分享前仍请检查是否含不准备公开的信息。

After success, you can copy a report containing the version, date, school name, catalog ID, protocol and course count, then paste it into Issues or Discussions yourself. This reporting entry point does not automatically upload anything over the network. Before sharing, check for information you do not want to make public.

q.zh: 教务导入如何工作？账号密码会被保存吗？
q.en: How does academic-affairs import work? Are my credentials stored?

inline.v: 应用在设备 WebView 中打开学校登录页面，或按对应协议获取课表。学校账号由你在学校页面输入，Sleepy 不把教务密码写入课表数据库。学校登录站点可能使用 WebView 会话或 Cookie，不能将“不写课表数据库”理解为学校页面绝不保存会话。排查材料需要脱敏。

The app opens the school's login page in an on-device WebView or retrieves schedules using the relevant protocol. You enter your school credentials on the school's page. Sleepy does not write the academic-affairs password into the schedule database. The school login site may use WebView sessions or cookies; not writing to the schedule database does not mean the school page never retains a session. Redact any troubleshooting material.

q.zh: 支持哪些导入格式？
q.en: Which import formats are supported?

inline.v: 可按内容识别以下格式：
此外支持 WakeUP 在线分享口令。在线口令需要联网，不属于本地文件解析。
The app can identify these formats from their content:
WakeUP online share codes are also supported. Online codes require a network connection and are separate from local file parsing.

q.zh: WakeUP 分享口令怎么导入？
q.en: How do I import a WakeUP share code?

inline.v: 在导入的粘贴入口输入分享口令或含口令的分享文字。应用向 WakeUP 的
api.wakeup.fun
发出两次 POST 请求，涉及
/pluto/app/antispam
和
/share_schedule/getv2
，取得分享课表后转换为本地数据。
口令过期、分享失效、网络或对方服务协议变化都可能导致失败。不要把口令发到公开问题单；普通手动编辑、已保存课表和离线格式导入不依赖这项第三方服务。
Enter the code, or share text containing it, in the import paste field. The app sends two POST requests to WakeUP's
api.wakeup.fun
, using
/pluto/app/antispam
and
/share_schedule/getv2
, then converts the shared schedule into local data.

Expired codes, invalid shares, network problems or changes to the service's protocol can cause failure. Do not post share codes in public issues. Ordinary manual editing, saved schedules and offline-format imports do not depend on this third-party service.

q.zh: `sleepy-v1` 是什么？
q.en: What is `sleepy-v1`?

inline.v: Sleepy 的原生纯文本交换格式，带
chk
完整性字段，可直接阅读并用于导入回环。它不要求替换旧 WakeUp 数据，WakeUp JSON、离线分享文本和 ICS 仍可继续导入。
Sleepy's native plain-text exchange format includes a
chk
integrity field. It is readable directly and supports export/import round trips. It does not require replacing older WakeUp data: WakeUp JSON, offline share text and ICS can still be imported.

q.zh: 可以导出什么？
q.en: What can I export?

inline.v: 课表可导出 WakeUp 兼容 JSON、ICS 和
sleepy-v1
。导出页和顶栏分享面板的分享文本使用原生 sleepy-v1，不是 WakeUp 的 URL 编码分享文本。作息表可导出 JSON 或 sleepy-v1。
Android 10 及以上将相应文件写到
Download/Sleepy/
，Android 8 至 9 使用应用缓存与 FileProvider 分享；文本使用系统分享面板。ICS 可交给系统日历或支持 iCalendar 的应用。单表导出不等于全量备份。
Schedules can be exported as WakeUp-compatible JSON, ICS and
sleepy-v1
. Share text from the export page and the top-bar share panel uses native sleepy-v1, not WakeUp's URL-encoded share text. Period timetables can be exported as JSON or sleepy-v1.
On Android 10 and later, the relevant files are written to
Download/Sleepy/

. Android 8–9 uses the app cache and FileProvider sharing; text uses the system share sheet. ICS can be passed to the system calendar or an iCalendar-compatible app. Exporting one schedule is not a full backup.

q.zh: 可以导出到小爱课程表吗？
q.en: Can I export to Xiaoai's class timetable?

inline.v: 可以。导出页提供“导出到小爱课程表”，在本地生成并校验周次、日期和作息字段后，通过深链交给小爱课程表导入器。能否接收和最终显示取决于设备上的小爱客户端。

Yes. The export page offers "Export to Xiaoai class timetable". It generates and validates week, date and period-timetable fields locally, then passes them to Xiaoai's timetable importer through a deep link. Whether it is accepted and how it appears depend on the Xiaoai client installed on the device.

q.zh: 可以直接写入系统日历吗？
q.en: Can it write directly to the system calendar?

inline.v: 可以。导出页可选择设备上的可写日历和日期范围，预览后确认，此时申请日历读写权限。支持应用调课和日历提醒。没有可写日历时可按需创建自有隐藏本地日历；增量指纹用于避免重复写入。已在日历端修改的事件有相应保留规则，不能把它当作双向实时同步。实验性第一节闹钟取决于日历应用和账号支持。

Yes. On the export page, choose a writable calendar on the device and a date range, preview, then confirm. Calendar read/write permission is requested at this point. Export supports applying class reschedules and calendar reminders. If no writable calendar exists, the app can create its own hidden local calendar on demand; incremental fingerprints help avoid duplicate writes. Events edited in the calendar app have retention rules, but this is not two-way real-time synchronization. The experimental first-period alarm depends on calendar app and account support.

q.zh: 如何完整备份或换机？
q.en: How do I make a full backup or move to a new device?

inline.v: 在“通用设置”的“数据迁移”导出
.sleepybackup
，包含课表、作息表、偏好和小组件配置。恢复可选合并或覆盖；合并保留本机课表并追加，同名偏好键采用备份值。覆盖只替换备份包含的课表与设置模块，包内缺少的偏好文件保留本机值。恢复前保管好原备份，单表 JSON 或 ICS 不是全量备份。
Use "Data migration" in "General settings" to export a
.sleepybackup

containing schedules, period timetables, preferences and widget configuration. Restore offers merge or overwrite. Merge keeps local schedules and appends restored ones; preference keys with the same name take the backup's values. Overwrite replaces only the schedule and settings modules included in the backup, keeping local values for preference files absent from it. Keep the original backup safe before restoring. A single schedule's JSON or ICS file is not a full backup.

q.zh: 需要哪些权限？
q.en: Which permissions are required?

inline.v: 常见可选权限包括：点学校定位时的前台位置、开启提醒时的通知、导出到系统日历时的日历读写、更新安装时的未知来源安装。精确闹钟、电池优化和勿扰访问通过相关系统设置配置。后台服务和开机恢复还受系统权限及省电策略约束。普通离线查看课表不要求授予所有这些权限；这不是完整 Manifest 权限清单。

Common optional permissions include foreground location when you tap school location, notifications when enabling reminders, calendar read/write when exporting to the system calendar, and unknown-source installation when installing an update. Exact alarms, battery optimization and do-not-disturb access are configured through the relevant system settings. Background services and restoration after reboot also depend on system permissions and power-saving policies. Ordinary offline schedule viewing does not require granting all these permissions. This is not a complete list of Manifest permissions.

q.zh: 能同时保存多张课表吗？
q.en: Can I keep multiple schedules at once?

inline.v: 可以。多张课表独立保存，各自可设置开学日期、最大周数和作息表。课表页支持时间网格、按天归组的周视图；今日页集中显示当天课程。横屏宽屏可使用双栏，平板竖屏回落单栏。

Yes. Schedules are stored independently, each with its own semester start date, maximum week count and period timetable. The schedule page offers a time grid and a week view grouped by day; the Today page brings together the day's courses. Wide landscape layouts can use two columns, while portrait tablets fall back to one.

q.zh: 同一时间有两门课会丢课吗？
q.en: If two courses overlap, is one lost?

inline.v: 重叠课程会保留在数据中。冲突布局提供叠放与查看入口，手动添加时会列出星期、节次、周次和冲突课程。视觉遮挡不表示课程被删除。

Overlapping courses remain in the data. The conflict layout stacks them and provides a way to view them. When adding a course manually, it lists the weekday, periods, weeks and conflicting courses. A course being visually covered does not mean it has been deleted.

q.zh: 撤回能撤回什么？
q.en: What can undo revert?

inline.v: 撤回、重做用于课表数据编辑，默认保留 5 步，可在“通用设置”的实验室调整深度。0 表示禁用，负数表示不设步数上限。新增编辑会清空可重做的分支；切换当前课表不是一条数据编辑记录。
历史保存在进程内存，进程结束后不保留，不能代替备份。具体操作能否撤回取决于是否纳入课表历史记录，不代表系统日历、外部应用或诊断控制台的所有修改都能恢复。

Undo and redo apply to schedule-data edits. The default history depth is 5 steps and can be changed in the lab section of "General settings". A value of 0 disables history; a negative value removes the step limit. A new edit clears the redo branch. Switching the current schedule does not count as a data-edit record.

History is held in process memory and is lost when the process ends. It is not a backup. Whether an operation can be undone depends on whether it is included in schedule history; this does not mean every change made through the system calendar, external apps or diagnostic console can be restored.

q.zh: 怎样只调整某一次课程？
q.en: How do I change just one class occurrence?

inline.v: 使用单次课程调整入口修改指定日期或周次中的课程实例，不改整门课的周期规则。需要改变整学期安排时，应编辑周期课程。单次调课和假期调课映射需要分别确认适用日期。

Use the single-occurrence adjustment entry point to change the course instance on a specific date or in a specific week, without changing the whole course's recurrence rule. Edit the recurring course if the change should apply across the semester. Check the applicable dates separately for single-occurrence adjustments and holiday reschedule mappings.

q.zh: 可以拖动课程、跨周移动和快速加课吗？
q.en: Can I drag courses, move across weeks and add courses quickly?

inline.v: 可以长按课程胶囊拖动，按网格落点调整课程实例。靠近左右周缘持续停留时，每 500 毫秒触发跨周翻页，直到离开边缘或达到周次边界。空白格可呼出预填星期和节次的快速加课胶囊。
这里描述 v1.0.63 的交互；后续 main 中的拖拽白边、滚动和松手翻页修正不自动包含在这个正式 APK 中。

Long-press a course capsule to drag it and adjust the course instance according to its grid drop position. Holding near the left or right week edge triggers a week turn every 500 milliseconds until you leave the edge or reach the week boundary. An empty cell can open a quick-add capsule with its weekday and periods prefilled.
This describes v1.0.63 behavior. Later fixes on main for drag white edges, scrolling and week turns on release are not automatically included in this official APK.

q.zh: 节次时间可以自动计算吗？
q.en: Can period times be calculated automatically?

inline.v: 可以手动逐节填写起止时间，也可按首节时间、课时长度、节数和课间模板推算。不同课表可绑定不同作息表，教务导入会处理相应作息。表头另有节次起止时间对齐选项，支持按展示习惯调整时间对齐方式。

You can enter each period's start and end manually or calculate them from the first period's start, class duration, number of periods and break template. Different schedules can use different period timetables, and academic-affairs import handles the corresponding period times. The header also has a period start/end time alignment option to suit your display preference.

q.zh: 时间滑杆上的幽灵标记是什么？
q.en: What is the ghost marker on a time slider?

inline.v: 调整区间或数值时，幽灵标记保留原始值供比较，不是第二条课程或第二个生效区间。课程节次、单次课程时间等编辑入口使用该参考设计；实际保存以确认后的新值为准。

When adjusting a range or value, the ghost marker keeps the original value visible for comparison. It is not a second course or a second active interval. This reference is used in editors such as course periods and single-occurrence times. The new value you confirm is the one saved.

q.zh: 周视图能显示日期吗？
q.en: Can the week view show dates?

inline.v: 可以。开启“显示星期”后，周视图课程旁和日详情栏显示真实日期，不必根据教学周反推。
Yes. With "Show weekday" enabled, the week view shows the actual date beside courses and in the day detail panel, so you do not have to work it out from the teaching week.

q.zh: 长课间怎么显示？
q.en: How are long breaks displayed?

inline.v: 长空档使用悬浮薄带标识，避免把整行拉成过高空白。课程卡保持对应行高，用餐时段按时间比例标识；表头时间行可以隐藏。

Long gaps use a thin floating band rather than stretching a whole row into a tall blank space. Course cards keep their corresponding row height, meal breaks are marked in proportion to time, and the header time row can be hidden.

q.zh: 有哪些小组件？
q.en: Which widgets are available?

inline.v: v1.0.63 有五个家族、13 个 widget 配置 XML：
采用同步
RemoteViews + Canvas
渲染，按桌面尺寸提供变体。独立“添加或管理桌面小组件”页提供添加画廊、实例管理与刷新，画廊以大卡为行高基准，小卡等比居中。后续开发中的新组件不算在这13种配置中。
v1.0.63 has five families and 13 widget configuration XML files:

items.v: : today and tomorrow in two columns.

inline.v: Widgets use synchronous
RemoteViews + Canvas

rendering, with variants for different launcher sizes. The separate "Add or Manage Home Screen Widgets" page provides an add gallery, instance management and refresh. Large cards determine each gallery row's height; smaller cards are proportionally scaled and centered. Widgets under later development are not included in these 13 configurations.

q.zh: 为什么 OPPO / 一加 / ColorOS 桌面上的 widget 可能空白？
q.en: Why might widgets be blank on OPPO, OnePlus or ColorOS launchers?

inline.v: 旧 Glance 异步 SessionWorker 在部分 ColorOS 桌面可能被冻结，主渲染已改为同步 RemoteViews 与 Canvas。仍异常时可先手动刷新，检查桌面权限和省电限制。渲染方式改变并不能保证所有启动器都不会限制更新。

The old asynchronous Glance SessionWorker could be frozen by some ColorOS launchers. The main renderer now uses synchronous RemoteViews and Canvas. If problems remain, try a manual refresh and check launcher permissions and power-saving limits. Changing the renderer does not guarantee that every launcher will allow updates without restrictions.

q.zh: Widget 颜色和应用不一致怎么办？
q.en: What if widget colors differ from the app?

inline.v: 应用与小组件共享主题和课程配色来源。改变主题会触发组件更新；仍显示旧内容时可手动刷新，检查系统限制，必要时重新添加。组件位置和设置先记录好，不要把删除重建当作无损操作。

The app and widgets share their theme and course-color sources. Changing the theme triggers widget updates. If old content remains, refresh manually, check system restrictions and re-add the widget if necessary. Record its position and settings first; deleting and recreating it is not a lossless operation.

q.zh: vivo 原子岛和桌面小组件是一回事吗？
q.en: Are vivo Atomic Island and home screen widgets the same thing?

inline.v: 不是。v1.0.63 的 OriginOS 桌面组件使用标准 Android AppWidget，不应宣传为已认证的原生“原子组件”。原子岛属于提醒的厂商实况卡片展示，是否出现由系统版本、权限和厂商能力决定。

No. v1.0.63's OriginOS home screen widgets use standard Android AppWidget and should not be advertised as certified native "atomic components". Atomic Island is a vendor live-card display for reminders. Whether it appears depends on the system version, permissions and vendor capabilities.

q.zh: 可以提前多少分钟提醒？
q.en: How many minutes before class can it remind me?

inline.v: 课前提醒支持 1 到 999 分钟。今日摘要、明日摘要和课前提醒分别设置总开关，各课表还有独立提醒开关。
Pre-class reminders support 1 to 999 minutes. Today summaries, tomorrow summaries and pre-class reminders each have their own master switch, and each schedule also has its own reminder switch.

q.zh: 课前提醒的横幅和流体云是什么关系？
q.en: How do banner and Fluid Cloud pre-class reminders relate?

inline.v: 两种模式互斥。横幅使用普通可划通知；流体云使用实验性实况卡片，受系统和厂商支持影响。切回横幅会停止流体云投放服务，不能把服务启动等同于系统已显示卡片。

The two modes are mutually exclusive. Banner mode uses ordinary dismissible notifications; Fluid Cloud uses experimental live cards and depends on system and vendor support. Switching back to banner stops the Fluid Cloud delivery service. A running service does not mean the system has displayed the card.

q.zh: OPPO / 一加 / realme 流体云已经接入了吗？
q.en: Is OPPO, OnePlus and realme Fluid Cloud integrated?

inline.v: 已接入 Android 16 Live Updates 通道，仓库有 RMX6688 / ColorOS 16 的行为记录；Pantanal / Seedling SDK 与 UPK 专用通道仍不能当作完整接入。可以使用提醒页的测试与结束入口检查本机表现。允许通知或显示“投放中”都不等于系统已经展示胶囊，旧系统或未获提升时可能只显示普通通知。详见
验证范围

The Android 16 Live Updates channel is integrated, and the repository contains behavior records for RMX6688 / ColorOS 16. The dedicated Pantanal / Seedling SDK and UPK channels cannot yet be described as fully integrated. Use the test and end controls on the reminders page to check your device's behavior. Notification permission or a "delivering" status does not prove that the system has shown a capsule. Older systems, or notifications not granted promoted status, may show only an ordinary notification. See the
verification scope

q.zh: 多张课表的提醒会刷屏吗？
q.en: Will reminders from multiple schedules flood my notifications?

inline.v: v1.0.63 的每日摘要和明日提醒把所有课表合并为一条通知，按上课时间排序；多张课表贡献内容时，每条带「[课表名]」前缀。点按进入统一每日议程，也支持给定日期直达。后续版本的课表选择行为不在本页正式版说明范围内。
v1.0.63 combines daily summaries and tomorrow reminders from all schedules into one notification, sorted by class time. When multiple schedules contribute, each entry has a
[schedule name]
prefix. Tapping opens the unified daily agenda, which also supports opening a specified date directly. Later versions' schedule-selection behavior is outside this page's release scope.

q.zh: 每张课表的提醒开关在哪里？
q.en: Where are the per-schedule reminder switches?

inline.v: 在“我的”的“提醒”页进入“课表提醒”。列表显示全部课表和各自开关，总开关关闭时也能先配置。
Open "Schedule reminders" from "Mine", then "Reminders". The list shows every schedule and its switch. You can configure them even when the master switch is off.

q.zh: 节假日、调休和上课勿扰怎么设置？
q.en: How do I set holidays, swapped days and class-time do-not-disturb?

inline.v: 通用设置管理节假日和调课映射，各课表分别保存调课。提醒页配置日期规则；授予系统勿扰访问后，可以上课自动勿扰、下课恢复。日期数据刷新需要联网，提醒展示还受设备后台策略限制。

General settings manages holidays and reschedule mappings; each schedule stores its reschedules separately. Configure date rules on the reminders page. With system do-not-disturb access granted, the app can enable do-not-disturb during class and restore it afterward. Refreshing date data requires a network connection, and reminder display is also subject to the device's background policies.

q.zh: 提醒是云推送吗？
q.en: Are reminders cloud push notifications?

inline.v: 不是，提醒在设备本地用 AlarmManager 调度，按系统能力使用精确或非精确路径。设备重启、应用更新后由 BootReceiver 恢复；通知、精确闹钟权限和省电策略仍可能影响送达。

No. Reminders are scheduled locally with AlarmManager, using exact or inexact paths according to system capabilities. BootReceiver restores scheduling after a device reboot or app update. Notification permission, exact-alarm permission and power-saving policies can still affect delivery.

q.zh: 关闭提醒后还会收到吗？
q.en: Will I still receive reminders after turning them off?

inline.v: 关闭应用总开关后不会主动安排新的提醒，各课表开关也能独立关闭。系统通知权限仍由 Android 管理；被系统或厂商拦截的通知需要到对应设置处理。

Turning off the app's master switch stops it from actively scheduling new reminders. Each schedule's switch can also be turned off independently. Android still controls system notification permission. Notifications blocked by the system or vendor require attention in the corresponding settings.

q.zh: 支持深色模式和系统动态色吗？
q.en: Are dark mode and system dynamic color supported?

inline.v: “我的”的“外观与主题”支持跟随系统、浅色、深色。Android 12 及以上可使用 Material You 壁纸动态色，不支持时使用预设色板。

"Appearance & theme" under "Mine" supports system, light and dark modes. Android 12 and later can use Material You wallpaper-based dynamic colors; preset palettes are used when dynamic color is unavailable.

q.zh: 能自定义主题颜色吗？
q.en: Can I customize theme colors?

inline.v: 可创建和编辑自定义主题，设置主色、次色、第三强调色和表面色调。编辑正在使用的自定义主题并保存后会重新应用配色，不需要切到其他主题再切回来。

You can create and edit custom themes, setting primary, secondary, tertiary accent and surface tint colors. Editing and saving the custom theme currently in use reapplies its colors without switching to another theme and back.

q.zh: 课程颜色是怎么决定的？能跟随主题吗？
q.en: How are course colors chosen? Can they follow the theme?

inline.v: 课程配色有经典撒色、跟随主题、自定义三档。经典撒色使用稳定黄金角 HSL 分布；跟随主题围绕主题色安排课程色；自定义使用所选种子色。课程色相按课程组保存，应用与小组件共享派生规则，不是所有模式都只使用黄金角。

Course colors have three modes: Classic, Follow Theme and Custom. Classic uses a stable golden-angle HSL distribution; Follow Theme arranges course colors around the theme color; Custom uses your chosen seed color. Hues are saved by course group, and the app and widgets share the same derivation rules. The golden-angle method is not used by every mode.

q.zh: 选中主题卡片会改变卡片尺寸吗？
q.en: Does selecting a theme card change its size?

inline.v: 选中指示器占固定槽位，选中与未选中保持相同布局尺寸，通过颜色和对勾区分状态。
The selection indicator occupies a fixed slot. Selected and unselected cards keep the same layout dimensions, with color and a check mark distinguishing their state.

q.zh: 液态玻璃和 Material 3 Expressive 动效支持哪些设备？
q.en: Which devices support liquid glass and Material 3 Expressive motion?

inline.v: v1.0.63 引入液态玻璃底栏及 Material 3 Expressive 转场和弹簧动效。实时着色器路径涉及 Android 13（API 33）及以上图形能力，系统支持程度会影响效果。
正式版在部分旧设备上的底栏显示仍有已知限制，不能保证与新系统同样的折射、模糊或完整降级；后续主线兼容修正不能当作 v1.0.63 已修复。不要因为图形效果的 API 33 条件，把整个应用最低版本误写成 Android 13。

v1.0.63 introduces a liquid-glass bottom bar, Material 3 Expressive transitions and spring motion. The runtime shader path depends on graphics capabilities available on Android 13 (API 33) and later. System support affects the result.

The release still has known bottom-bar display limitations on some older devices. It cannot guarantee the same refraction, blur or a complete fallback on those devices. Later compatibility fixes on main must not be described as already fixed in v1.0.63. The API 33 requirement for graphics effects does not change the whole app's minimum version to Android 13.

q.zh: 支持 Android 13 主题图标吗？
q.en: Are Android 13 themed icons supported?

inline.v: 包含 monochrome 图层，支持 Android 13 及以上系统主题图标，仍需启动器支持并开启。它与 Android 12 起的应用内动态色是两项能力。
The app includes a monochrome layer for themed icons on Android 13 and later. The launcher must also support and enable them. This is separate from in-app dynamic color, available from Android 12.

q.zh: 如何编译？
q.en: How do I build it?

inline.v: 需要 JDK 17 和对应 Android 工具链。要复现本页正式版本，应检出 v1.0.63：

zh.text:
git clone https://github.com/lingion/sleepy.git
cd sleepy
git switch --detach v1.0.63
./gradlew assembleDebug

inline.v: Windows 使用
gradlew.bat assembleDebug
，产物位于
app/build/outputs/apk/debug/
。源码 main、PR 与自动 debug 包可能包含此版本之后的改动；最新 CI 用法单独见
构建指南
，不代表正式 APK 已包含这些改动。
You need JDK 17 and the corresponding Android toolchain. To reproduce the release described on this page, check out v1.0.63:

en.text:
git clone https://github.com/lingion/sleepy.git
cd sleepy
git switch --detach v1.0.63
./gradlew assembleDebug

inline.v: On Windows, use
gradlew.bat assembleDebug
. Output is in
app/build/outputs/apk/debug/
. Source on main, PRs and automated debug builds may include later changes. See the
build guide
separately for current CI usage; it does not mean those changes are included in the official APK.

q.zh: 如何跑测试？
q.en: How do I run tests?

inline.v: 测试位于
app/src/test/
，覆盖导入解析、数据、冲突、周次、主题和组件等模块。不要将真实凭据、会话或个人课表放进测试夹具。
Tests are in
app/src/test/
, covering import parsing, data, conflicts, weeks, themes, widgets and other modules. Never put real credentials, sessions or personal schedules in test fixtures.

q.zh: 本机调试控制台是只读的吗？
q.en: Is the local debug console read-only?

inline.v: 不是。该接口需主动启用，在
回环地址监听，请求通过
X-Sleepy-Token
认证。解锁后可查询，也可创建、修改、删除部分课表、课程、作息表和偏好。正式构建对目录覆写、mock 或触发等端点另有限制，不能据此把整个接口称为只读。
只用于本机诊断，禁止暴露到公网或向不可信工具交出令牌。操作会修改数据，先备份；会话重置不保证撤销对任意真实数据的修改。接口边界见
控制台说明
No. This interface must be enabled explicitly. It listens on the loopback address
and authenticates requests through
X-Sleepy-Token

. Once unlocked, it can query data and also create, modify or delete some schedules, courses, period timetables and preferences. Release builds impose additional restrictions on endpoints such as catalog overrides, mocks and triggers. Those restrictions do not make the whole interface read-only.

Use it only for local diagnosis. Do not expose it to the public internet or give its token to untrusted tools. Operations can modify data, so back up first. Resetting a session does not guarantee that changes to arbitrary real data will be undone. See the
console documentation
for interface boundaries.

q.zh: 如何贡献？
q.en: How do I contribute?

inline.v: 先读公开的
CONTRIBUTING.md
，提交边界清楚的变更。学校适配需要公开协议证据、脱敏夹具和测试；缺陷报告应包含版本、步骤和必要的脱敏截图，不要提交个人数据。
Read the public
CONTRIBUTING.md

first and submit a clearly scoped change. School adaptations need public protocol evidence, redacted fixtures and tests. Bug reports should include the version, reproduction steps and any necessary redacted screenshots. Do not submit personal data.
